page.div: The readiness effect controls how a failed result appears. Dynamic uses the control's own severity; Information never blocks; Advisory needs review; Blocking prevents Ready. A technical failure always prevents Ready because the check did not complete.
Evaluators are whitelisted Python extension points supplied by installed modules. Business configuration does not execute arbitrary Python code.
